gap: No result ChatGPT got states that BLUETTI's own US store sells the Elite 100 V2 (1,024 Wh, 1,800 W) with a 200 W panel as one $699 SKU. That is $199 less than the $898 the station ($499) and BLUETTI's 200 W panel ($399) cost separately, and only $20 more than the $679 bundle with a 100 W panel.
standout_why: I compared against ecosolarkits.com (cited in both chats) and wattfolk.com (cited in chat 2). Ecosolarkits lists whole-kit bundles from Jackery, Anker, Rich Solar and Sungold. Its top 'tool shed' pick is the Jackery 1000 v2 + 200 W at $879. It never compares a bundle with buying the parts separately, and it names no approved-store kit except Sungold. Its Sungold SGKT-3PRO price ($2,485, checked 2026-11-09) is also out of date: sungoldpower.com shows $2,237 today. Wattfolk lists Amazon panel kits behind 'Check Price' links and says nothing about carts, bundle SKUs or gifts. I could not read agripure.org, cited in chat 1, because WebFetch returned a self-signed-certificate error. The finding is new and useful, but it does not decide which products go in the set. It also rests on the bundle panel being the SP200L, which the store page does not name.
kit_items: Power station: BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 (1,024 Wh LiFePO4, 1,800 W). It covers the 'lights + fan + tool charging' tier both chats named. Its 12–60 V, 20 A, 1,000 W solar input has room for a second 200 W panel later.
Solar panel: the 200 W panel in BLUETTI's 'Elite 100 V2 + 200W' SKU, which image filenames suggest is the SP200L. The bundle is cheaper than buying the station and panel separately.

Budget alternative in one cart: the ALLPOWERS P1800 + 200 W bundle ($531, 1,024 Wh, 1,800 W, up to 650 W solar via XT60). The bundle page would not load (HTTP 429), so I could not confirm which 200 W panel it includes.
Larger alternative: Growatt INFINITY 2000 PRO (2,048 Wh, 2,400 W) + Growatt 200 W panel. They can share one cart at $799 + $199 = $998, but I found no bundle SKU.

carts.bundle_sku: Elite 100 V2 + 200W, $699.00. Separately: $499 + $399 = $898, so the bundle saves $199. Use the bundle SKU. The page lists no free gift. It shows a Black Friday spend-tier discount ($50 off $2,000+), which this kit doesn't reach, and 5% off a first order for newsletter sign-ups.

P1800 + 200W, $531.00. Separately: $399 + $139 (SE200) = $538, or $399 + $199 (SP033) = $598. The bundle is $7–$67 cheaper depending on which panel it holds, and I could not confirm which one (HTTP 429). I could not read gift information either.

findings.label: Bundle price vs. parts bought separately
findings.note: storecheck.py search and product on bluettipower.com. Station alone $499 (/products/elite-100-v2-portable-power-station). '200W Portable Solar Panel' alone $399 (/products/bluetti-sp200l-solar-panel-200w). $499 + $399 = $898, and $898 − $699 = $199. The bundle page does not name the panel. WebFetch saw SP200L only in image filenames, so treat the saving as resting on that assumption.
